</ticket>

For ticket t005, check whether Lumen already supports a dark mode, and whether it can follow the operating system's light/dark setting automatically. Report only the facts found, and say so if nothing is documented.

content.content: Ticket t005 is a low-priority feature request in which the customer asks for a dark mode that follows the system setting automatically, and says they currently switch it by hand every evening. Searching the tickets for "dark mode" found no documentation of whether Lumen supports dark mode or automatic OS-based switching. The only other hit, t040, is about offline mode and plan storage, so it is not relevant.

input.task: Write a reply to ticket t005 thanking the customer for the dark mode feature request, saying it has been logged for the product team, and that the automatic follow-the-system-setting idea is noted. Do not promise that it will be built, and do not promise any date. Do not claim whether dark mode currently exists, since no documentation was found.

content.content: Thank you for the feature request, and for explaining how you currently switch modes each evening. We've logged your suggestion for automatic dark mode that follows your system setting with our product team, and we've noted it as a useful improvement. We can't commit to a timeline or say whether it will be added, but we appreciate you helping us understand what would make Lumen work better for you.
